tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

All Vehicles and ancillary services to be supplied under the Contract shall have their origin in eligible source countries, defined in the IBRD Guidelines for Procurement and all expenditures made under the Contract will be limited to such Vehicles and services.

The Bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of its Tender, and The Executive Engineer, H&FW Engineering Division, Bangalore hereinafter referred to as the Employer, will in no case be responsible or liable for these costs, regardless of the conduct or outcome of the bidding process.

Service provider shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of Karnataka Public Procurement Portal (KPPP) on or before the last date of bid submission.

Service provider is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement Portal (KPPP) portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Service provider shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
Conditional Request for Proposal will not be accepted.

The Service provider is expected to examine all instructions, forms, terms and conditions in the RFT document. Failure to furnish all information required by the bidding documents or submission of a Tender not substantially responsive to the RFT document in every respect will be at the Service provider risk and may result in rejection of its Tender.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.

All the formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Service provider. Necessary certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents section can be used for this purpose.
Service provider is required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.

If the numbers of page to be attached in one particular attachment is more then all the pages can be put into one folder zipped and then attached or else all the pages can be pasted in one word file and then this word file could be converted to PDF (portable documents format) format and then attached. (Please contract Help Desk for more assistance Phone: 91-8046010000/91-8068948777/91-09240214000/91-09240214001)

The Service provider are bound to furnish the original certified documents to the employer within a weeks time from the day of opening of technical bid for verification, failing which the Request for Proposal will be considered as non responsive.
All other Terms and conditions are applicable as per the Request for Proposal.
